landing.title: Personalized Smart Farming & Resource Advisory System
landing.subtitle: Sign up or log in to get customized crop suitability recommendations, live district weather telemetry, financial ROI forecasts, and government scheme guidance tailored to your exact farm.
landing.feature1Desc: Captures District, Soil Type, Land Size (Acres), and Water Source so every recommendation is custom-tailored.
landing.feature2Desc: Shows compatibility scores out of 100 for seasons like Kuruvai, Samba, and Navarai alongside scaled NPK fertilizer requirements (Urea, DAP, MOP).
landing.feature3Desc: Clearly contrasts input costs (seeds, labor, fertilizers) against gross revenue, net profit, and ROI percentage, incorporating local Tamil Nadu government subsidies.
landing.feature4Desc: Displays district-wise temperature, humidity, rain probability, and wind speed using Open-Meteo integration.
landing.feature5Desc: Simulates 5 simultaneous sluice gate requests using CountDownLatch synchronization to showcase robust backend engineering.

water.title: Shared Reservoir Canal Water Allocation
water.subtitle: 5-Thread Java concurrency simulation executing simultaneous canal sluice gate requests using CountDownLatch synchronization.
water.info: Simulates 5 simultaneous sluice gate requests demanding 15 KL each from a 50 KL reservoir using CountDownLatch synchronization. Exactly 3 channels are granted (45 KL) and 2 are denied to showcase robust backend engineering.
